description: K4 Analytics K4 Analytics turns Power BI into a live planning and data collection platform. Trusted by global organizations, K4 enables users to natively write back into Power BI, leveraging the familiar Excel-style interface and collaborating across departments in real-time, eliminating the need for disconnected spreadsheets, manual uploads, and data replication. K4 enables seamless alignment between planning, reporting, and analysis — empowering teams to work confidently within the tools they already know and trust, unlocking enterprise-grade capabilities such as advanced data entry, allocations, modelling, version control, scenario management, consolidation, and workflow — all natively embedded inside Power BI. Key Capabilities Include: Native Power BI write-back Leverage Excel-style interface Re-use existing Excel models & logic Budgeting / Planning / Forecasting / Consolidation Multi-level write-back (top-down, bottom-up, middle-out) What-if scenarios & version control Workflow approvals, comments & audit trails Driver-based allocations Seamless integration with Microsoft ecosystem (Power BI, Excel, Fabric, Azure, SQL, etc.) Secure, governed, enterprise-ready Use Cases FP&A / xP&A – Budget, forecast, and plan directly in Power BI Sales Forecasting – Input sales data and model pipeline scenarios Operational Planning – Plan resources, production, and capacity Workforce…
